title: Ferrofluid
description: A pool of black ferrofluid lying on a record sleeve, glossy as a mirror. A magnet follows your pointer under the paper: hover and the pool leans after it, press and it stands up in a lattice of spikes that bend toward the field and slump back into a puddle when you let go.
intent: Factory round 1. Material: ferrofluid. Verb: attract. A liquid that answers a field you hold.
